sources.snippet: 🦾 Overview Cypher is an AI-powered code summarizer tailored for efficient navigation of large codebases. Using a dedicated Modelfile, Cypher captures essential code relationships and dependencies, generating optimized, architecture-aware summaries that enable AI to offer insightful support for architectural decisions without analyzing the entire source code.
